findings.title: Unreported write to src/config.py by a child of `make test`
findings.description: Hand-labeled fixture expectation, not detection output. The process tracer recorded python tools/fmt_config.py (pid 53102, descendant of the Bash tool call toolu_fx02_bash_make_test) writing src/config.py. No hook payload, tool output or agent message reports this write.
findings.recommended_next_step: Decide whether `make test` should be allowed to rewrite source files during agent runs, or have the agent run pytest directly.
